day_shape: 60 items: Iran's parliament confirms sanctioned missile veteran Akhlaghi Ketabchi as defence minister, Lavrov due in Tehran Monday, Trump threatens to 'finish the job' as Netanyahu vows to topple Tehran, Egypt approves troop deployment to Saudi Arabia; no UK or OFAC output.

threads.label: New Iranian defence minister confirmed
threads.summary: Iran's parliament approved Mehrdad Akhlaghi Ketabchi, a sanctioned veteran of the IRGC missile programme, as defence minister, ending interim leadership after the February killing of Aziz Nasirzadeh in US-Israeli strikes. President Pezeshkian framed the vote as a unity message, and Defa Press published photo coverage of Akhlaghi's arrival at the ministry.

threads.label: Trump-Netanyahu Iran escalation rhetoric
threads.summary: Trump said the US could 'soon finish the job' on Iran and gave Netanyahu a 'complete and total endorsement' nine days before Israel's 27 October election, while Netanyahu vowed Israel was ready to strike Iran without US support and topple Tehran's government. Iran International and Jerusalem Post reported Iran's Supreme National Security Council secretary issuing counter-threats against Israel and the US.

threads.label: Iran diplomacy: Lavrov, Baghdad, Hormuz
threads.summary: Iran's foreign ministry announced Russian FM Sergei Lavrov will visit Tehran on Monday, while FM Araghchi met Iraqi FM Fuad Hussein at the OIC meeting in Baghdad, with Iraq offering to broker Iran-Gulf Arab talks. Iran also urged the US to accept a six-day proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

threads.label: Red Sea / Houthi coalition building
threads.summary: Egypt's National Defence Council approved deploying forces to Saudi Arabia, and the UAE president met the Saudi defence minister on regional security as Houthi attacks intensified. Jerusalem Post ran analyses on a prospective anti-Houthi regional coalition and possible Israeli assistance to Riyadh, while Defa Press carried a Yemeni military warning to Aramco staff and shareholders.

threads.label: IRGC-linked threats and claims
threads.summary: IRGC advisor Gen. Naqdi claimed on Defa Press that Iran now possesses the technology of the US 14-ton bomb used in the 12-day war, and Basij head Taeb said Iran's response to any next war would be 'unpredictable'. Parliament Speaker Ghalibaf warned regional governments against funding AI firms assisting military action against Iran.

events.title_en: Search and recovery of 7 sacred defence martyrs in various operational areas
events.summary_en: Search and recovery of 7 sacred defence martyrs in various operational areas: Teams searching for martyrs in the past week succeeded in finding the bodies of seven martyrs from the eight-year sacred defence period. These martyrs were found in various operational areas including two martyrs in Cheilat, one martyr in central Fakkeh, one martyr in Pasgan Rubout post, one martyr in Badr operational area, one martyr in Umm al-Rasas and one martyr in Talaiyeh. Various search teams have been searching for the bodies of sacred defence martyrs in the south and west of the country for years.

events.title_en: Egypt's National Defence Council approves deployment of forces to Saudi Arabia
events.summary_en: Egypt's National Defence Council approves deployment of forces to Saudi Arabia: Official Spokesman of the Office of the President of Egypt announced that this country's National Defence Council, after holding a session and reviewing regional developments, approved the deployment of Egyptian military personnel to Saudi Arabia. Ambassador Mohamed El-Sharawi, Official Spokesman of the Office of the President of Egypt, stated in this regard that the National Defence Council conducted a comprehensive review of current regional developments and the dangerous developments the region is witnessing, particularly the attacks being carried out against Saudi Arabia, and on this basis adopted the following decisions: 1- Full support and absolute solidarity with Saudi Arabia, believing that Saudi Arabia's national security is linked to Egypt's national security and the Arab world's security
